abstract: The outcome of clinical therapy of adult nonseminomatous testis tumor presenting with negative human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) at our hospital is reported. Of 45 nonseminoma, 28 cases showed negative hCG and they had no chorionic element. Embryonal carcinoma was found in 14 cases (50%), teratoma in 5 cases (17.9%), and teratomatous mixed tumor in 9 cases (32.1%). The 5 year actuarial survivals were 94% for stage I disease, 40% for stage II and 16.6% for stage III. Prophylactic irradiation was given to the patient with stage I disease and no relapse occurred in the irradiated area, but later, neoplasms had spread by vascular dissemination in 3 cases (17.6%). In the treatment of stage II disease, radiotherapy has proved unsatisfactory and retroperitoneal lymph nodes dissection was a choice of modality. Of 11 patients with lung metastasis including vascular dissemination from stage II and III disease, 3 cases (27.3%) were cured by localized radiotherapy and chemotherapy of the pre-VAB regimen era.
abstract_ja: 本施設における、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)陰性を呈した成人非セミノーマ型精巣腫瘍の臨床治療成績を報告する。非セミノーマ45例中28例がhCG陰性で、絨毛成分は認められなかった。胎児性癌が14例(50%)、奇形腫が5例(17.9%)、奇形腫を伴う混合腫瘍が9例(32.1%)にみられた。5年生存率は病期Iで94%、病期IIで40%、病期IIIで16.6%であった。病期Iの患者に予防的照射を行い、照射野内の再発は認めなかったが、3例(17.6%)では後に血管内播種による腫瘍の広がりがみられた。病期IIの治療では放射線療法は不十分であることが示され、後腹膜リンパ節郭清が治療選択となった。病期II・IIIからの血管内播種を含む肺転移11例のうち、3例(27.3%)は局所放射線療法とVAB療法導入以前の化学療法により治癒した。
